reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open 2026-07-28: the AREVA AUP still reconciles generated VNXAU across Ethereum, Q, Polygon, Solana, and Base to 13,100.00 brutto grams on Philoro Edelmetallhandel AG's custody statement as of December 31, 2025, finds the Philoro statement is in VNX Commodities AG's name, documents a 1.13-token Solana difference from holder burns, and finds generated supply did not exceed the reported gold balance. The live VNX Gold page still states every token is backed by allocated physical LBMA-certified gold with segregated storage in Liechtenstein and a serial-number allocation lookup. AREVA did not physically observe the gold or validate quality, value, or legal property rights.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: AREVA AUP reconciliation of VNXAU supply to gross grams on Philoro's custody statement
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The backing asset and custody provider are identified, but gold quality, valuation, bar-level identity, legal property rights, and liquidation timing were outside the AUP procedures.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: AREVA's December 2025 report names Philoro in Liechtenstein and reports all 13,100 gross grams there, but did not physically observe the gold or validate quality, legal rights, segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, or rehypothecation restrictions. Philoro is retained as the historically identified provider, without a current allocation share. The issuer case study re-retrieved on 2026-10-20 describes independent custody in Liechtenstein and Switzerland without naming current providers or allocations; the transparency archive still lists only the December 31, 2025 gold report. Current provider allocation is therefore wholly unverified, not measured 100% Philoro. This correction preserves the original review start and historical composition/report dates and grants no current custody or reserve-assurance credit.
